Cache entry update fails to retrieve updated value

When updating an existing cache entry with a new value, the updated value cannot be retrieved. The cache appears to lose the mapping between the key and the updated entry.

#### Steps to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/allegro/bigcache/v3"
    "time"
)

func main() {
    cache, _ := bigcache.NewBigCache(bigcache.DefaultConfig(10 * time.Minute))
    
    // Set initial value
    cache.Set("key1", []byte("value1"))
    
    // Update with new value
    cache.Set("key1", []byte("value2"))
    
    // Try to get updated value
    entry, err := cache.Get("key1")
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
        return
    }
    
    fmt.Printf("Expected: value2\n")
    fmt.Printf("Actual: %s\n", string(entry))
}
```

Expected output:
```
Expected: value2
Actual: value2
```

Actual output:
```
Error: Entry not found
```

The cache entry becomes inaccessible after updating an existing key with a new value.
